name: Brits VIP Party ft. PinkPantheress
desc:
Celebrate the biggest night in British music for the first time ever on Roblox! From February 8th through the 13th, you’re invited to the BRITs VIP Party event where you can:

🎶 Dance all weekend to an exclusive concert from PinkPantheress

🤝 Meet your favorite BRITs Nominees and artists

🕵🏾‍♀️ Hunt for BRIT Awards while driving through the streets of London

🛍️ Shop exclusive BRIT Awards & PinkPantheress-inspired virtual merch

The PinkPantheress concert premieres within the experience on February 11 at 9 AM PST / 5 PM GMT and will re-air hourly all weekend.

Find when and which artists will be hosting meet-and-greets in the BRITs official Roblox group: https://www.roblox.com/groups/13942340/The-BRIT-Awards#!/about

Background music courtesy of Monstercat.
